messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> Incident fired: PD-12345 for private-controlplane-prod-eu-west-1 - 503 error rate > 5% over 2m

aj: Acked. Oncall infra.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by aj

maria: joining. seeing a spike in controlplane-frontend 503s and increased latency. no obvious node restarts yet.

sahil: assigning to me for mitigation. @aj can you pull recent control-api logs and upstream health?

aj: grabbing logs and tailing upstreams. quick sample:
```
2026-03-14T15:40:21Z control-api GET /v1/health 200
2026-03-14T15:41:03Z control-api POST /v1/serve 503 upstream timeout
2026-03-14T15:41:04Z control-api POST /v1/serve 503 upstream timeout
```

maria: that pattern suggests backend model-hosts or peering to the customer's VPC losing connectivity to the control plane. customer: corp-ambra (private VPC in eu-west-1).

henry: marking P1 — customer-impacting. Affected: corp-ambra, partner-beta (both eu-west). Observed: management/API calls getting 502/503; model workers still accepting inference traffic locally.

lucy: can CS ping the customer for confirmation? @cs-rep pls notify corp-ambra SRE.

cs-rep: DM sent to corp-ambra SRE. They confirm intermittent drops on their egress to our controlplane subnet for ~4m; their network team is investigating.

sahil: mitigation plan: 1) enable per-customer fallback routing to hosted control proxy for affected customers, 2) restart controlplane-proxy deployment in eu-west-1, 3) collect tcpdump if flaps continue, 4) escalate to network SWAT if no fix in 30m.

aj: toggling fallback for corp-ambra in Console -> Routing -> Overrides -> add corp-ambra -> target hosted-proxy-eu -> enable.

pd-bot: Change applied: fallback route enabled for corp-ambra by aj

maria: restarting controlplane-proxy pods to clear potential stale connections:
```
kubectl -n private-controlplane-eu-west rollout restart deploy/controlplane-proxy
kubectl -n private-controlplane-eu-west get pods -o wide\```

aj: pods are restarting. one pod hit CrashLoopBackOff briefly, fetching pod logs:
```
controlplane-proxy-5f7b: Error connecting to peer 10.240.12.3: dial tcp i/o timeout
```

henry: that log fits an intermittent peering/egress path issue. Because fallback is enabled, traffic for corp-ambra should be routed to hosted proxy now.

cs-rep: corp-ambra reports errors dropped from ~12% -> ~0.8% after fallback applied. They're seeing improved API stability.

sahil: good — keeping PD open until we confirm stability for 30m. Next: collect tcpdump from controlplane-proxy and ask customer for a pcap on their egress side. If unresolved in 30m escalate to network-SWAT and cloud-provider NOC.

lucy: I'll take the handoff at 16:10 UTC. pls add runbook + PD link.

maria: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-vpc-controlplane-fallback.md
PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-12345

incident-bot: PD-12345 status updated: Mitigated (fallback applied) — monitoring for 30m

aj: leaving notes here and closing Slack thread. Will keep PD open until controlplane fully stable. :thumbsup:

sahil: thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: sahil. Draft ETA: 48h. :rotating_light:
